title: Oswal Pumps Ltd - 544418 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue INR2,064cr (+44%) and PAT 18% margin, but FY27 H1 revenue may decline, EBITDA margin guided to 22-23% from 24.9%, and receivable days stuck at 152-155 with KUSUM 2.0 timing unconfirmed.

capex.quote: we will infuse around INR350 crores of total capex this year in FY27

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA margin 22-23% vs 24.9%

triggers.highlight: operating EBITDA margin for FY27 to be in range of 22.0% to 23.0%

triggers.label: Receivable days 155 vs 157 prior

triggers.quote: For FY27, we are targeting overall growth of 20% to 25% over the previous year.

we expect operating EBITDA margin for FY27 to be in range of 22.0% to 23.0%
